cosmetics.cape.clarity.desc: The signature grey Clarity Visuals cape.
cosmetics.cape.dark.desc: Deep obsidian cape with mysterious dark aura.
cosmetics.cape.fire.desc: Blazing fiery cape with ember glows.
cosmetics.effect.fire.desc: Blazing fire aura that swirls around you.
cosmetics.effect.frost.desc: Delicate drifting snowflakes and icy cold mist.
cosmetics.effect.stars.desc: Sparkling astral stars that hover in your wake.
cosmetics.hat.halo.desc: A soft glow above your head.
cosmetics.subtitle: Choose your loadout. Capes, hats and wings sync with Clarity Visuals users on the server.
cosmetics.title: Cosmetics
cosmetics.wings.angel.desc: Feathered wings with a soft glow.
cosmetics.wings.crystal.desc: Gleaming wings made of pure crystalline shards.
cosmetics.wings.dragon.desc: Mighty draconic wings with powerful presence.
descriptions.qj.shifttap: Briefly holds sneak after landing a crit to fake shift taps.
descriptions.ql.antiinvis: Shows the TAB-list tag above invisible players: nickname and rank.
descriptions.ql.aurora: A cinematic night sky with layered aurora curtains, stars, the Milky Way, a moon halo and shooting stars.
descriptions.ql.blockoverlay: Highlights the targeted block with theme color.
descriptions.ql.crosshair: Custom crosshair that highlights when aiming at an enemy.
descriptions.ql.customvitals: Custom hotbar: HP/food/exp bars (+ armor/air/mount) in Link style. Hidden in creative.
descriptions.ql.drochka: All players hold their crotch and jerk their hand.
descriptions.ql.emotions: Emote wheel on hold (V): character poses for you and other players, synced via the emotion server.
descriptions.ql.fogblur: Adds a depth-based blur to distant world geometry.
descriptions.ql.fortnitedamage: Shows damage numbers next to the target
descriptions.ql.freelook: Lets you look around in third-person without rotating the player.
descriptions.ql.hands: Applies shader effects to first-person hands.
descriptions.ql.hitcolor: Tints players with the selected color when they are hit.
descriptions.ql.hitrange: Hit-range ring around the player (turns red when an enemy is near).
descriptions.ql.itemphysics: Adds smooth dropped-item physics with grounded settling and soft airborne spin.
descriptions.ql.jumpcircles: Spawns glowing circles when you jump.
descriptions.ql.killeffect: Plays a visual effect when you kill an entity.
descriptions.ql.killstreak: Kill streak HUD banner at the top of the screen: level, x N counter and combo timer. Players always count, mobs are optional.
descriptions.ql.lowfog: Low volumetric mist with slow drifting banks, soft scattering and floating glowing motes.
descriptions.ql.motionblur: Frame-blend motion blur of the world (trails on turning/moving). HUD stays sharp.
descriptions.ql.rain: Volumetric rain: drops, splashes, mist, lightning and wet reflective puddles.
descriptions.ql.sakura: True 3D sakura petals with flips, wind gusts, soft glow and a petal carpet on the ground.
descriptions.ql.sandstorm: Desert storm with fast sand streams, dust clouds, distance haze and procedural wind ripples on surfaces.
descriptions.ql.selfnametags: Enable your nametag while in third-person.
descriptions.ql.superresolution: Upscales rendering with Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (FSR/DLSS) for higher FPS.
descriptions.ql.tnt timer: Shows an explosion countdown panel for primed TNT near you.
descriptions.ql.trails: Spawns a particle trail behind you in third-person.
descriptions.ql.viewmodel: Adjusts hand position and size with items.
descriptions.ql.winter: Winter: snowfall with flakes, low drifting snow and snow-covered ground.
descriptions.ql.world: Changes the visual part of the world
descriptions.ql.zoom: Smooth zoom while holding a key.
descriptions.qm.autoaccept: Automatically accepts friends on teleport requests.
descriptions.qm.autonear: Automatically sends /near with the configured amount.
descriptions.qm.autoreply: Automatically replies to incoming private messages with a preset text.
descriptions.qm.cmddelay: Runs configured commands repeatedly with a delay.
descriptions.qm.cosmetics: Cosmetics: wardrobe (capes/hats/wings) + effects (halo, spheres, body trail, pets, animations, Naruto). Wardrobe is in settings.
descriptions.qm.hitsound: Plays a custom sound when you hit an entity.
descriptions.qm.hwhelper: Helps in PvP with HV items.
descriptions.qm.itemscroller: Quick-moves items while dragging with held right mouse button.
descriptions.qm.lockslot: Prevents dropping (Q) items from selected hotbar slots.
descriptions.qm.pvpsave: Blocks /hub during PvP until repeated confirmation.
descriptions.qm.sounds: Sounds for combat events: kill, killstreak, own totem pop, death, low health.
descriptions.qm.tapemouse: Automatically clicks the selected mouse button.
descriptions.qm.totemcounter: Displays your total totem count near the crosshair.
descriptions.qm.totemtracker: Shows players who pop a totem and whether it was enchanted.
descriptions.qm.waypoints: Creates quick waypoints and automatic event/death waypoints.
descriptions.qn.allskins: Sets one chosen skin for all players.
descriptions.qn.auctionhelper: Highlights the cheapest and most cost-effective lot in the auction.
descriptions.qn.party: Shows party markers and lets you place pings for the group.
descriptions.qn.streamermode: Hides your name, donation info, and sensitive data in the UI.
descriptions.qo.cooldownshud: HUD element: item and ability cooldowns on screen.
descriptions.qo.coordinateshud: HUD element: your coordinates on screen.
descriptions.qo.inventoryhud: Shows your inventory in a liquid glass panel.
descriptions.qo.keybindshud: HUD element: list of active modules and their keybinds.
descriptions.qo.livegui: HUD element: quick module toggles right on the screen.
descriptions.qo.potionhud: HUD element: active potion effects with timers.
descriptions.qo.scoreboardhud: HUD element: scoreboard sidebar on screen.
